scheme_name: Financial Support Scheme for Farm Mechanization (FSSM)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual farmer registered under the Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme or belong to eligible groups such as SKUS, PACS, FPO, FPC, FIG, SHG, LAMPS approved by government institutions
Minimum cultivated land of 0.5 acre (RoR) is required for purchase of power tiller or solar photovoltaic water pumping system
Beneficiary or spouse cannot reapply for any FSSM scheme within four years of the last subsidy release
Scheme does not cover large machines such as tractors, rice transplanters above 4 rows, or combine harvesters
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 50‑60% of the machinery price, up to a maximum of ₹3,00,000, for eligible farmers to purchase power‑operated farm equipment.
